about_summary:
Chocobot Guardian is a local Windows desktop application for utilities and security, developed independently with a local-first and privacy-focused approach.

For complete information, visit the About page on the official blog.
developer_summary:
Chocobot is developed by Hasby Prasetya Saprudin under the pen name Choco.

For full profile and official contact, visit the Developer page on the official blog.
license_summary:
Chocobot is protected by a license that governs usage, distribution, and modification. A license summary is available in the application.

For the full license text, visit the License page on the official blog.
